modes.localhost: Only this computer can connect: apps and browsers running here. Nothing on your network sees the gateway.
modes.lan: Phones, tablets and other computers on the same Wi-Fi or office network can connect. Everyone signs in with their own account.
modes.internet: Reachable from anywhere, through a secure proxy or tunnel that you set up. The gateway itself speaks plain HTTP and never touches your router.

text.addresses_sub: Other devices use one of these to connect.
text.trust_text: A proxy on this computer always names the real client (X-Forwarded-For), for sign-in lockouts and the audit log. On: a proxy on another machine may too.
text.trust_danger: Only when your own proxy on that machine sits in front of every request: otherwise anyone can choose the address the gateway sees.
text.empty_origin: Type an origin, for example https://gateway.example.com.
text.applies: Changes apply to the next request: no restart.
text.non_admin_proxy: Only an admin can change these.
text.non_admin_mode: Only an admin can change who can reach this gateway.
text.confirm: Before you open the gateway to the internet
text.no_address: The gateway found no address to show.
